name: hello
title: Hello
description: The smallest agent: a scripted model, no key needed. Use it to try deploying and running tasks.

name: researcher
title: Web researcher
description: Answers questions by reading web pages and cites its sources. Needs uv for its fetch tool.

name: writer
title: Writer
description: Turns notes and facts into a clear draft. No tools.

name: editor
title: Editorial team
description: Plans a piece, asks the researcher for facts and the writer for a draft, then checks it. Deploy researcher and writer too.

name: pr-reviewer
title: Pull request reviewer
description: GitHub sends pull request events to a signed webhook; the agent reads the change and comments. Needs a GitHub token.

name: fleet-steward
title: Fleet steward
description: Every 30 minutes reports new failures and warnings (bursts, quiet runs, blocked queues, held providers); every morning a cost report. Read-only.

name: approval-triage
title: Approval triage
description: Summarizes each pending approval with a recommendation, so a person can decide quickly. Never decides itself.

name: assistant
title: Console assistant
description: The chat assistant in the console: answers questions about the fleet and makes changes you confirm, with your permissions.

name: coder
title: Coding agent
description: Makes code changes in one project folder on this machine: reads, edits and runs the project's tests (each command asks first). Set the folder in mcp.json.

name: ci-fixer
title: CI fixer
description: A failing CI job arrives on a signed webhook; the agent reproduces it in a local clone, finds the cause and fixes it. Never pushes.

name: support
title: Support agent
description: Answers customer messages from your documentation folder with sources, and flags the ones a person must handle.

name: incident-responder
title: Incident responder
description: An alert arrives on a webhook; the agent reads your runbooks and the fleet and writes the impact, likely cause and next steps. Read-only.

name: data-analyst
title: Data analyst
description: Answers questions about a Postgres or SQLite database with read-only SQL and shows the queries it ran.
